import json, os
import psycopg
job='bcba0db7-3f46-4748-a0e2-a9b6e4c24d6b'
url=os.getenv('APP_DB_URL','').strip()
with psycopg.connect(url) as conn:
  with conn.cursor() as cur:
    cur.execute("""
      select event_id, created_at, action, entity_type, coalesce(entity_id,''), coalesce(details_json,'')
      from audit_events
      where coalesce(entity_id,'')=%s
         or coalesce(details_json,'') ilike %s
      order by event_id asc
      limit 200
    """, (job, f'%{job}%'))
    rows=[{'event_id':r[0],'created_at':r[1],'action':r[2],'entity_type':r[3],'entity_id':r[4],'details_json':r[5]} for r in cur.fetchall()]
    print('AUDIT_FOR_JOB', json.dumps(rows))
print('AUDIT_DONE')
